thread:
maya: quick check — about to run a dry perf sweep for sable-lite-13b weights. weights are at s3://redwood-models/sable-lite/v1/weights.pt. can someone confirm tokenizer + config we should point the catalog at?

sam: use the HF tokenizer at hf://sable-lite/tokenizer-v2, but we applied a tiny PAD/SOS mapping patch for qlora exports. without it we see off-by-one BOS in some evals. i can drop the patch here.

sam: patch snippet:
```
# apply after loading tokenizer
if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
    tokenizer.add_special_tokens({'pad_token': '[PAD]'})
# remap old SOS -> new BOS id if needed
if tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids('[SOS]') == 0:
    tokenizer._convert_token_to_id['[BOS]'] = 0
```

ravi: heads-up: serving config must enable kv_cache and set max_seq_len=2048. otherwise the perf runner OOMs when batching >8. also validate `tensor_parallel` matches the compiled kernel.

zoe: i ran a quick smoke earlier — single-request p50 ~ 180ms on a g4dn-type node with batch=1, but tail spikes if prefix caching is disabled. caching + batch=4 hit ~120ms/p50 with throughput ~160 tps in our harness.

maya: great — for the dry sweep i'm going to test batch sizes [1,2,4,8,16] and sequences [128,512,1024]. target is to find the knee for latency vs throughput. scheduling these runs now.

ravi: also add a run with `prefetch_kv=true` vs `false`. that toggles the new cache path and changes memory footprint.

maya: noted. also -- which quantization profile should I use? recommend q4f32 or q5k?

sam: start with q4f32 to match catalog baseline. if latency is good, try q5k for extra perf, but compare quality on our short eval set (qa/commits).

zoe: small gotcha: tokenizer-v2 emits an extra token for trailing newline in some English samples — filter that in the eval pipeline or results will have slightly higher perplexity.

maya: thanks — i'll add a strip_trailing_newline step in the eval harness. setting PR to add config + patch for tokenizer, and a small README for the s3 path + expected shard layout. pinging for review: https://git.redwood/infra/ml-onboard/pulls/342

ravi: i'll review in a bit. once maya posts perf artifacts, can we decide catalog `recommended_batch` default? i'd prefer conservative default of 4 and an explicit fast path in the console for 8/16.

maya: agreed. plan: upload perf CSVs to artifact store under artifacts/sable-lite/v1/dryrun-2286504321/, will include latency percentiles, mem usage, and cost-estimates per 1M tokens.

ci-bot: perf-run started — job id perf-2286504321-01. running sweep on infra-tag: gpu-modern-small. i'll post results when complete. :mechanical_arm:

zoe: sweet. if any run shows >2x variance in p95 across repeats, call it out — we should investigate kernel selection or numa placement.

maya: will do. rough ETA ~45m for full sweep. thanks all. :thumbsup:
